messages:
ops-bot: PAGER — severity: high — GPU ECC correctable spike detected on node gpu-17 (rack r3c2). Xid counts rising, auto-alerting oncall.

sam: ack — I'm on it. Any visible customer impact yet?

devon: seeing multiple container restarts for runtime-service on gpu-17, ~10 restarts in last 5m. Logs look like driver reset. Snippet: 
```
NVRM: GPU 0000:01:00.0: Xid (PCI:0000:01:00): 116, ECC error: correctable
kernel: nvidia 0000:01:00.0: Xid 116 at 0xabc
containerd: container "runtime-service" exited code 255, restarting
```

maya: noticed p95/p99 latency and increased 5xx from inference-api in us-west-2, about 3% error rate. Opening customer bridge and tagging impacted teams.

customer-bridge-bot: Bridge opened: INC-4891. Notifying impacted customers and creating incident timeline document.

sam: mitigation plan: cordon gpu-17, start draining non-critical pods. Devon — can you migrate warm models off this node (prefer gpu-12) and scale down heavy deployments?

devon: running commands now: 
```
kubectl cordon gpu-17
kubectl drain gpu-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```
Drain in progress. Stateful pods require manual eviction; scaling down model replicas to avoid data loss.

maya: running temporary scale commands to move heavy models: 
```
kubectl -n prod scale deployment big-embedder --replicas=0
kubectl -n prod scale deployment big-embedder --replicas=2 --node-selector='gpu=12'
```
Traffic shifting, watching error rate.

sam: telemetry shows PDU power-cycle events on rack r3c2 ~2h ago, possible voltage/thermal jitter causing ECC drift. Looping in hardware team.

ryan: taking over oncall (handoff). Summary: driver resets triggered by correctable ECC spikes -> container restarts and brief customer errors. Actions: node quarantine + drain, customer bridge open, will coordinate host reboot and driver checks.

devon: after drain, Xid types changed — seeing intermittent 13 and 31 in dmesg. Recommend host reboot and quarantine for soak. Initiating reboot now.

sam: agreed. Proposed checklist: 
- mark gpu-17 unschedulable/quarantine
- full host reboot (controlled)
- collect nv-host logs and full dmesg after reboot
- evaluate driver rollback/upgrade (candidate: try 535.55)
- if Xid persists post-reboot, flag for hardware replacement

ryan: customer-impact summary for bridge: ~3% of inference requests returned 5xx for ~12 minutes during the incident window; primary root cause: node-level ECC-induced NVIDIA driver resets. Draft message in bridge, will publish after post-mitigation sanity check.

maya: will send customer update in 30m with actions taken and ETA. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: INCIDENT LOGGED: INC-4891 | severity: high | node gpu-17 quarantined | live metrics: https://telemetry.redwood/graphs/4891

ryan: adding follow-ups to runbook: correlate PDU events with ECC spikes, add a stanza for "power jitter" as a possible trigger, and include steps to preemptively drain nodes in affected PDUs. Handing off to sam for 2h follow-up. :eyes:
